{ ...order, status: newStatus } : order )); }; const handleDeleteOrder = (id) => { setOrders(orders.filter(o => o.id !== id)); }; const handleDeleteShipper = (id) => { setShippers(shippers.filter(s => s.id !== id)); }; const completedOrders = orders.filter(o => o.status === "Hoàn thành").length; const pendingOrders = orders.filter(o => o.status === "Chưa giao").length; const ongoingOrders = orders.filter(o => o.status === "Đang giao").length; const totalRevenue = orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.amount, 0); return (
